evidence: Prompt and completion are not logged by default. We do zero logging of your prompts/completions, even if an error occurs, unless you opt-in to logging them.
All new users receive a small free allowance to test out OpenRouter.

observations.title: Structured Outputs
observations.claim: Structured outputs varían por endpoint/proveedor, no solo por modelo, y la compatibilidad puede cambiar.
observations.evidence: Support is determined per endpoint, not just per model: the same model may be served by multiple providers, and only some of those providers may support structured outputs.
observations.verification: Documentación oficial de structured outputs consultada el 2026-10-26.

observations.title: Client Tools
observations.claim: Con tool calling, el modelo sugiere la función y la aplicación ejecuta la herramienta; no la ejecuta autónomamente el modelo.

observations.verification: Documentación oficial de tools consultada el 2026-10-26.

observations.title: Provider Logging

observations.title: Free Models Router
